text:
erin: Quick weekend poll  rooftop cookout (5pm) vs boardgame bonanza in the lounge (7pm)? grill or dice? :grill: :game_die:

josh: Cookout for me. I will man the grill and bring a big batch of chimichurri. :fire:

priya: Boardgames please. my new copy of Cascadia arrived and it's begging for an audience. :maple_leaf:

mark: Both? early cookout then boardgames after? keeps everyone fed and entertained. :hamburger: :boardgame:

tina: Id do both but im on kid-duty until 6:30. Would love to join games after.

erin: Love the both plan. Weather check says clear but breezy. rooftop wind might scatter napkins. anyone have weights?

josh: I have those little grill bricks and a tub of landscape rocks? could anchor the tablecloths.

priya: Heads-up: lounge is free from 7pm but might need chairs. I can bring two folding chairs + my portable lamp.

mark: Suggestion: cookout 52-6:45, quick tidy, then boardgames 7-10pm. If wind or stray embers are a concern we can move the cookout to the courtyard.

erin: Quick checklist idea:
```
- grill tongs + lighter
- serving platters (2)
- napkin weights (rocks/bricks)
- veggie option labeled
- extra chairs + lamp
- trash bags + compost bins
```

josh: Ill bring tongs, a small propane tank, and chimichurri. Will prep a marinated portobello for vegetarians.

priya: Ill bring Cascadia + Wingspan (short), and a tiny scoreboard for bragging rights. :trophy:

tina: Id love a designated kid zone suggestion if we do rooftop. otherwise ill join games after bedtime.

erin: Good call. If kids are present well set up a small folded blanket area with snacks on the courtyard instead. safer.

josh: Also FYI, rooftop rules: no open flames within 3ft of the planter boxes. ill keep grill in the center and a small extinguisher nearby. safety-first.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Rooftop Cookout + Boardgame Night" Sat 5:30 PM (Cookout) & 7:00 PM (Boardgames)  RSVP: https://calendar.company/events/48291

priya: RSVP'd for games. bringing victory snacks (chocolate + salted nuts). will label for allergens.

mark: GIF: https://giphy.com/grill-party.gif :sunglasses:

tina: RSVP for boardgames only. will join at 7:15 if kids cooperate. :crossed_fingers:

erin: Quick note: please bring reusable plates/cutlery to cut down on waste. also label items with dietary tags (v/gf/nf).

josh: Will do. Also bringing a small loaf of sourdough to soak up chimichurri.

priya: If its windy we pivot to courtyard cookout + lounge games. everyone ok with that contingency?

mark: Fine by me. courtyard has benches and less wind. thumbs up. :thumbsup:

erin: Vote tally: rooftop cookout 2, boardgames 1, both 3. Looks like a combo night. See yall saturday! :party_parrot:
